issues.finding: After assuming some member of alpha satisfies phi, the proof invokes a least element of alpha 'which is phi.' A least element of alpha need not satisfy phi; the argument requires a least member of the nonempty subset of alpha whose members satisfy the predicate, formed by Separation.
issues.proposed_resolution: Explicitly form the nonempty phi-satisfying subset of alpha by Separation and take its membership-least element. That element satisfies phi, is an ordinal, and has no smaller ordinal satisfying phi.

translation_treatment: The Javanese proof supplies the missing bounded subset and least-member step without adding or reordering formulas. The trichotomy, Burali-Forti proof, historical quotation, corollaries and unsolved exercises otherwise follow the frozen source; source bytes remain unchanged.
